protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: Real CWE-346 Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking. Spring first-party https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-41700 (HIGH, 2026-06-10) requires GraphQL WebSocket transport, cookie session auth, and no custom Spring Security WebSocket Origin enforcement; a malicious origin can then run GraphQL operations with the victim cookie. CVE.org CNA https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-41700 is state=PUBLISHED (not rejected), CWE-346, CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N. Source-to-sink at first write: WebFluxGraphQLAutoConfiguration.graphQLWebSocketEndpoint maps properties.getWebSocketPath() via SimpleUrlHandlerMapping to getSubscriptionWebSocketHandler() with no CorsConfigurationSource; SubscriptionWebSocketHandler.handle consumes handshakeInfo.getHeaders() and executionChain.execute(webInput) without Origin checks. WebMvc sibling later constructs new WebSocketHttpRequestHandler(handler, new DefaultHandshakeHandler()) with no OriginHandshakeInterceptor.
